## Setup

You'll use data from Pew's 2024 Religious Life Survey to answer the questions below. These data have been resampled, filtered, and recoded to match the values used in the article:

-   Burge, Ryan. 2026. [The Political Takeover: Why Ideology, Not Faith, Drives the Culture War.Links to an external site.](https://www.graphsaboutreligion.com/p/the-political-takeover-why-ideology) Graphs about Religion. (non-paywalled version [available on the course website](https://umd.instructure.com/courses/1412240/assignments/7703159))

You can find a description of the variables included in this data set [at the end of this document](#variable-description)


::: {.callout-important}
**For this assignment, do not use any packages other than the three loaded below:**
```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(see)
library(performance)
loc<-'https://github.com/Neilblund/SDSB340-Fall-2026/raw/refs/heads/master/Data/rls_subset.rds'
rls<-readRDS(url(loc))


```
:::

## Question 3

## Question 7

In Burge's analysis, he uses `income_numeric` as one of the predictors for support for greater acceptance of transgender people:

```{r}
#| eval: false
#| echo: true

burge_model <- glm(
  support_trans ~ trad + ideo3 + gender + educ + white + income_numeric,
  data = rls,
  family = binomial(link = 'logit')
)

```

What assumptions does this make about the relationship between income and beliefs about acceptance of transgender people? What would change if we decided to use the categorical version of `income` instead in our regression model instead? Can you make a case either version of the model?




# Variable description

+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Variable Name       | Description                                                                                                                             | Values                                                               |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| support_abortion    | Whether respondent supports a right to an abortion in all or more cases                                                                 | Oppose, Support                                                      |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| support_ssm         | Whether respondent supports or opposes allowing gays and lesbians to marry legally                                                      | Oppose, Support                                                      |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| support_homo        | Whether respondet supports or opposes the statement that "Homosexuality should be accepted by society"                                  | Oppose, Support                                                      |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| support_trans       | Whether the respondent supports or opposes "greater acceptance of people who are transgender"                                           | Oppose, Support                                                      |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| gender              | Respondents gender self identification                                                                                                  | Men, Women                                                           |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| income              | Respondents family income in the last year                                                                                              | Categorical8 levels from "Less than \$30,000" to "\$150,000 or more" |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| ideo3               | Whether the respondent identifies as a liberal, moderate, or conservative                                                               | liberal, moderate, conservative                                      |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| educ                | Respondent's highest level of education attained                                                                                        | HS or less, Some College, College Grad, Postgrad                     |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| trad                | Respondent's religious tradition                                                                                                        | Non-Religious, Catholic, Black Protestant, Mainline, Evangelical     |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| birthdecade         | Decade of respondent's birth                                                                                                            | 7 levels from "1940s or earlier" to "2000s"                          |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| birthdecade_numeric | Numeric recode of birthdecade. 1= 1940s or earlier, 2 = 1950s, 3= 1960s ...                                                             | 1 - 7                                                                |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| income_numeric      | Numeric recode of income. 1= Less than \\\$30,000, 2 = \\\$30,000 to less than \\\$40,000 3= \\\$40,000 to less than \$50,000, etc.     | 1 - 8                                                                |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
| white               | Race recoded as dichotomous (white or not white)                                                                                        | Not-white, White                                                     |
+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------+
